frequency_question: How often did these episodes result in annualized quarterly output growth falling below 1.5%?
membership_rule: Includes periods of Federal Reserve tightening cycles where the target federal funds rate was held restrictive (above estimated neutral) through a 12-month window preceding the target quarter. Excludes exogenous pandemic shocks or major supply-side commodity price shocks unrelated to domestic policy will.
coverage_note: 4 named; representative of post-war intentional monetary cooling phases.
known_gaps: Excludes minor mid-cycle adjustments with ambiguous policy intent.
skeleton: 4 instances sampled across distinct post-war monetary tightening soft-landing or cooling environments under sustained restrictive policy rates.
validity_reason: Macroeconomic structural transmission mechanisms and Federal Reserve operational frameworks remain stable through this horizon.
